data.title: Total Revenue by Region

provenance.sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM `project-e8b1593d-009a-4822-abf`.agentic_bi_demo.orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

assumptions: Revenue represents gross order revenue in USD prior to any returns or refunds, queried directly from orders at order grain.
Data reflects the full synthetic period from January to September 2026.
All orders in the orders table are included in the aggregation.

skills_used.name: Revenue evidence guide
skills_used.description: Review revenue by region and reporting assumptions.

data.message: Explaining the result and its assumptions

data.explanation:
Total gross revenue across all four regions is $118,951.00 USD. By region:
- West: $31,657.00
- North: $29,959.00
- South: $28,999.00
- East: $28,336.00

Reporting Assumptions:
- Revenue reflects gross order revenue in USD prior to any returns or refunds, queried at the order grain.
- Figures represent synthetic data covering the period from January to September 2026.
- All orders present in the orders table are included in the aggregation.
followups: What is the average order value by region?
How does regional revenue trend on a month-over-month basis?
What is the total order volume per region?
